posts.hook: A rocket's upper stage came back from orbit and a tower plucked it out of the air
posts.caption: spacex caught a starship upper stage with its launch tower for the first time, though the booster catch on the same flight was called off. elon musk and other tech executives signed a petition asking nvidia to reinstate jensen huang, and linkedin and monster removed more than 1,000 fake job postings after a cbc investigation. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: SpaceX catches the Starship upper stage for the ==first time==
slides.desc: The planned booster catch was aborted. Each half has now been caught, not yet on one flight.

slides.title: Musk and other tech executives petition Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
slides.desc: A petition from peers has no formal weight with the board or ordinary shareholders.

slides.title: Why Huang could lose Nvidia: he had ==no super-voting shares==
slides.desc: Forbes: Zuckerberg, Dell and Spiegel hold majority voting power. Huang did not.

terms.gloss: stock that gives a founder extra votes per share

slides.title: A data center developer asks Oracle and Meta to backstop its electricity
slides.desc: Bloomberg: Applied Digital sought billions in guarantees before leases were final.

slides.title: LinkedIn and Monster remove more than 1,000 fake job postings
slides.desc: They came down only after a CBC investigation found them.
